seasonRows.notes: LEH (Limited Entry Hunting): draw only, not a general open season

plan: Drive: from Buckinghorse River, about 181 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 97, Hwy 97 (Alaska Hwy).
Park: 58.63187, -122.70257, where the truck road ends (Hwy 97 (Alaska Hwy)); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 1.3 km on unnamed roads and trails by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 350 m W, climb about 0 m.
Hunt: moose, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-49, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-06-30, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BF-moose-atv-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-49: about 1,090 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.10 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.3 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
